objectives: Add a calendar so the student picks the date and the day is filled in automatically.
Add a time picker and a reason, then submit the request.
Attach the saved student details to every request.

mcqs.q: Why use a calendar to pick a date instead of typing it?
a: It avoids wrong formats and impossible dates
mcqs.why: A picker only offers real dates the user can tap.

mcqs.q: Why does the calendar grey out weekends and past dates?
a: Rules in the app stop impossible choices before they are made
mcqs.why: Good apps prevent errors instead of reporting them later.

mcqs.q: What does it mean to attach saved student details to a new request?
a: The app re-uses stored data instead of asking again
mcqs.why: Linking records saves typing and avoids mistakes.

mcqs.q: Why show a confirmation screen after a request is sent?
a: It tells the user the action worked
mcqs.why: Feedback after an action builds trust.
